mandate.promise: Know what changed, why it matters, and what to watch next.
mandate.proof: Every important conclusion carries evidence, invalidation, timestamp, and outcome history.
mandate.icp: Self-directed, research-intensive swing/position investors following 10–100 names.

north_star.metric: Day-90 retained contribution profit generated by activated users attributable incrementally to Marketing
north_star.note: Accruing — requires two mature cohorts and holdout-validated incrementality. No data yet (wave0).

self_deception_checks.name: no_training_on_unverified_attribution
self_deception_checks.desc: The lobe does not train on its own unverified attribution as truth. Only holdout-validated incrementality results may update the model.
self_deception_checks.note: Growth Science department owns attribution; publishing depts are consumers only.

self_deception_checks.name: no_delete_losing_cells
self_deception_checks.desc: Losing experiment cells are never deleted. Append-only ledgers are the enforcement mechanism.
self_deception_checks.note: All ledgers are JSONL append-only; the auditor samples for deletions.

self_deception_checks.name: no_relabel_failed_metric_as_success
self_deception_checks.desc: A failed primary metric cannot be relabeled as a success after the fact. Pre-registered primary metric stays fixed for the experiment lifecycle.
self_deception_checks.note: Experiment registry records hypothesis+primary_metric before any result is written.

self_deception_checks.name: no_self_grading_by_publishing_dept
self_deception_checks.desc: A publishing department may not grade its own work alone. Attribution and scoring live in Growth Science.
self_deception_checks.note: Scorecard writes are gated to growth_science and office_cmo departments.

self_deception_checks.name: no_engagement_as_revenue_proxy
self_deception_checks.desc: Engagement (likes, views, clicks) may not claim revenue impact without holdout-validated evidence.
self_deception_checks.note: Incrementality holdout required before any engagement metric enters budget allocation.

self_deception_checks.name: no_creator_payout_ignoring_refunds
self_deception_checks.desc: Creator/referral conversions include payout, refund, and chargeback costs in retained_contribution before credit is assigned.
self_deception_checks.note: Economics formula always subtracts payouts and refunds before attribution.

self_deception_checks.name: no_marketing_response_changes_market_scores
self_deception_checks.desc: Marketing response (clicks, subs, revenue) cannot change a Neural Web market-engine score or signal.
self_deception_checks.note: Typed boundary between marketing control plane and scored-path surfaces.

self_deception_checks.name: no_authority_widening_on_anomalous_win
self_deception_checks.desc: Authority is not widened based on a single anomalous win. Minimum sample size and holdout validation are required.
self_deception_checks.note: Authority ladder gates: passed_shadow + clean_receipts + no_unresolved_corrections + survived_red_team.

departments.name: Office of the Autonomous CMO
departments.primary_outcome: Maximize durable contribution profit and strategic distribution power through capital allocation, org design, and growth thesis ownership.
non_goals: Review routine newsletter assembly or approved lifecycle emails.
Approve standard chart cards or low-budget in-envelope experiments.
Be the chief copywriter or day-to-day content producer.
departments.retirement_test: Retire if a simpler governance mechanism achieves equivalent attribution accuracy with lower inference cost over 90 days.

departments.name: Growth Operating System and Finance
departments.primary_outcome: Reliable autonomous execution at known cost.
non_goals: Create editorial content or marketing campaigns.
Make audience or channel strategy decisions.
departments.retirement_test: Retire if a managed external execution platform provides equivalent reliability, auditability, and cost transparency.

departments.name: Market, Audience, and Opportunity Intelligence
departments.primary_outcome: Identify the best audience/problem/event/channel opportunities before competitors.
non_goals: Produce editorial content or campaign assets.
departments.retirement_test: Retire if opportunity detection recall falls below 60% on major events for two consecutive quarters.

departments.name: Intelligence Products and Public Tools
departments.primary_outcome: Turn user uncertainty into useful, shareable product experiences.
non_goals: Build advertising creatives or promotional landing pages.
departments.retirement_test: Retire a specific product when it generates fewer than 10 qualified acquisition events per month for 60 days.

scorecard.primary_metric: public value use events per week

departments.name: Editorial, Creative Studio, and Data Newsroom
departments.primary_outcome: Create distinctive, timely, multi-format work from every worthy opportunity.
departments.retirement_test: Retire if creative output fails distinctness checks or produces zero qualified-reach events for 30 consecutive days.

scorecard.primary_metric: qualified-reach events driven by studio assets

departments.name: Distribution Network
departments.primary_outcome: Place useful intelligence where the right audience already gathers.
departments.retirement_test: Retire a channel adapter if it produces warnings, policy flags, or zero qualified-reach events for 60 days.

scorecard.primary_metric: qualified-reach events per channel per week

departments.name: Lifecycle, Conversion, and Monetization
departments.primary_outcome: Move the right visitor from first value to repeated value to retained paid use.
non_goals: Optimize sign-up volume rather than retained contribution.
departments.retirement_test: Redesign if day-30 retained-contribution forecast is negative for two consecutive cohort reviews.

departments.name: Creator, Partner, and Community Infrastructure
departments.primary_outcome: Make external people and communities more effective because Mastermind exists.
departments.retirement_test: Retire a partner if they produce zero incremental retained contributions after two payout cycles.

scorecard.primary_metric: incremental retained contributions from partner channel

departments.name: Growth Science and Self-Improvement
departments.primary_outcome: Determine incremental causal impact and improve the institution.
non_goals: Produce editorial content or run distribution channels.
Make final budget allocation decisions (recommend only).
departments.retirement_test: Redesign if attribution methodology fails holdout validation on two consecutive quarter reviews.

departments.name: Autonomous Trust, Policy, and Red-Team Office
departments.primary_outcome: Keep autonomy truthful, recoverable, and commercially durable.
non_goals: Be a routine human approval gate for low-consequence publishing.
Own marketing strategy or budget decisions.
Report to any department it audits.
departments.retirement_test: The auditor is never retired; it may be redesigned if it generates more than 5% false-positive quarantines per month.

authority_ladder.name: Observe
authority_ladder.desc: Read and diagnose — crawl site, inspect funnels, monitor trends.

authority_ladder.name: Create
authority_ladder.desc: Create drafts and prototypes — copy, scripts, landing pages, mock reports.

authority_ladder.name: Shadow
authority_ladder.desc: Run against live inputs without external effect — simulated campaign, private preview, dry-run partner research.

authority_ladder.name: Publish
authority_ladder.desc: Publish through owned, approved lanes — site, newsletter, established social formats.

authority_ladder.name: Engage
authority_ladder.desc: Interact and transact inside standard terms — replies, partner provisioning, affiliate offers.

authority_ladder.name: Allocate
authority_ladder.desc: Move spend and resources inside caps — paid tests, creator economics, model budgets.

authority_ladder.name: Organize
authority_ladder.desc: Create/merge/retire departments and rewrite playbooks — new regional desk, channel closure, model change.

authority_ladder.name: Root
authority_ladder.desc: Change legal-entity commitments or root credentials — bank, binding signature, registration, identity proof.
